subject: Foundry Labs — founder subsidy packaging & onboarding pricing
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@foundrylabs.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eli Turner <eli.turner@foundrylabs.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: founder subsidy + packaging for IgniteTrack cohort

Hi Maya / Ben —

Thanks for taking the time yesterday on the call. Foundry Labs is lining up our next IgniteTrack cohort (starting April) and we are evaluating partners for runtime credits and discounted pricing for participating founders. A few things we want to understand from Redwood: 

- Can a "founder subsidy" be granted at the cohort level and then allocated to startup accounts (multiple sub-accounts)?
- Any hard caps on what subsidy funds can cover (e.g., embeddings, fine-tuning, dedicated infra)?
- Do unspent subsidies roll over between months or cohorts?
- Are there any restrictions around resellers / marketplace partners using the subsidy on behalf of their startups?

If you can send a simple table showing packaging options (starter subsidy, growth subsidy, committed discount) and a sample mutual action plan (who signs what, timelines), that would be super helpful. We also need to understand if there's an onboarding credit or services bundle included.

Attn: we'll need to loop in our security lead for questionnaire items once commercial terms land.

Thanks — looking forward to a short pricing sheet or bullets we can share with the cohort by next week.

— Asha
Founder Partnerships | Foundry Labs
asha@foundrylabs.ai
attachments: none
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@foundrylabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: founder subsidy + packaging for IgniteTrack cohort

Asha —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then a suggested packaging we can model for IgniteTrack: 

TL;DR: Yes — we can issue cohort-level subsidy credits that are distributed to sub-accounts. There are configurable caps and usage rules, and we offer an onboarding services bundle on top of the credits. Rollover of unused funds is negotiable per cohort (we typically allow up to 10% carryover for 3-month programs). Reseller use is allowed but needs explicit listing in the MAP and SOW.

Suggested packaging (high level):
- Starter Subsidy (no commit): $10k cohort credit, usable across text generation + embeddings, expires 90 days after issuance; no rollover.
- Growth Subsidy (commit threshold): $25k cohort credit + 20% discount on committed monthly consumption for first 6 months; unlimited sub-account distribution; 10% rollover allowed for remaining months of cohort window.
- Dedicated Onboarding Bundle: up to 8 engineer-hours of onboarding + one workshop (up to 2 hours) and a security readiness review; one-time delivery.

Overage pricing: when subsidy is exhausted, consumption billed at listed hosted rates unless there is a reserved capacity contract in place — in which case committed rates apply.

Next steps I propose: I’ll attach a short pricing table and a draft MAP you can share. Can you confirm: (1) number of expected startups that will receive credits (ballpark), and (2) whether you will need allowance for marketplace/reseller redemption?

Attachments: subsidy_structures_v2.xlsx (pricing table), MAP_foundry_2026.pdf (draft mutual action plan)

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Head of GTM Programs | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@foundrylabs.ai>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: founder subsidy + packaging for IgniteTrack cohort

Asha —

Quick commercial note from my side: if Foundry is open to a 12-month reserved capacity (minimum commitment), we can extend a 25% discount on committed monthly consumption for the first 6 months and increase the cohort subsidy by a one-time $5k top-up. That helps us plan capacity and gives your founders a lower effective unit cost.

If you prefer not to lock a 12-month reserve at the cohort level, we can still do the Growth Subsidy path (25k credit + 20% discount) but the top-up wouldn't apply.

Happy to set a short call to walk through numbers next week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Lead, Strategic Programs | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: founder subsidy + packaging for IgniteTrack cohort

Team —

Couple of constraints from finance/legal worth flagging before we send a final offer to Foundry: 
- We can approve one-time onboarding/subsidy top-ups up to $15,000 at the Director level without exec sign-off. Anything above that needs VP approval.
- Committed discounts >20% need VP approval (25% is uncommon without a clear committed ARR baseline).
- Marketplace/reseller redemption must appear in the SOW and requires a brief indemnity clause (we'll loop Legal).

My recommended commercial package to propose to Foundry:
1) Growth Subsidy: $25k cohort credit allocated to startups (no more than 40 startups unless we tier usage per startup)
2) Conditional Top-up: $5k top-up if Foundry commits to a 12-month reserved pool equal to X monthly throughput (we’ll fill numbers in the MAP once we see usage expectations)
3) Discount: 20% off committed consumption for first 6 months (finance ok at Director level)
4) One-time onboarding credit: up to $10k for shared services (workshops, config)

I’ll draft a DocuSign-ready term sheet and a GDrive pricing sheet — ping me if you want different thresholds.

Links: DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/envelopes/1234-Foundry-SUBSIDY-DRAFT
Pricing workbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-foundry-pricing

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Foundry Labs — founder subsidy packaging & onboarding pricing

Maya / Ben / Karthik —

Thank you — this is exactly the level of detail we needed and is very helpful. A few clarifying asks before we share with cohort stakeholders: 

1) Can you add a one-sentence definition for "what subsidy covers" in the MAP (we want to show founders which product lines are covered vs billable overage).
2) Confirm whether the $25k Growth Subsidy can be split across a mix of up to 30 startups (we may not use all 40).
3) Marketplace question: Foundry partners sometimes register startups via our marketplace partner account; we need explicit confirmation that redemption via our marketplace is permitted if we include the indemnity clause.

We are very interested in the conditional top-up tied to a reserved pool — please put the DocuSign draft in trackable status and we will review internally. Also can you attach a single security questionnaire (or link to your SOC2 summary) so our security team can start the review in parallel?

Proposed next step: short call Thursday at 10am PT to finalize MAP language and confirm numbers. Can you confirm availability?

Appreciate the speed — will aim to have cohort stakeholders ready to accept the MAP pending the security check.

Best,
Asha Rao
Founder Partnerships | Foundry Labs
